scripts.text:
[La Ed]
There MUST be a treasure hidden in that place!
scripts.translation:
[拉·埃德]
那個地方一定藏著寶藏！

scripts.text:
[Haith]
If we find it, people will no longer think we're losers~!!
scripts.translation:
[海斯]
只要找到寶藏，大家就不會再把我們當窩囊廢了~！

scripts.text:
[La Ed]
Finally!
scripts.translation:
[拉·埃德]
終於！

scripts.text:
[Haith]
Let's go find that treasure!
scripts.translation:
[海斯]
讓我們去找那個寶藏吧！

scripts.text:
[La Ed]
Let's do it~ !!
scripts.translation:
[拉·埃德]
就這麼辦~！！

scripts.text:
[La Ed]
By the way...do you think he
would tell us about such a
great treasure so easily?
scripts.translation:
[拉·埃德]
話說回來...那麼了不起的寶藏，他會輕易告訴我們嗎？

scripts.text: Hm? What treasure?
scripts.translation: 嗯？什麼寶藏？

scripts.text:
[La Ed]
Wha--?! when did you start listening to us?!
scripts.translation:
[拉·埃德]
什麼？！你什麼時候開始偷聽的？！

scripts.text:
[Haith]
Huh...seems like you wanna know
more about the treasure. Well,
this information doesn't come cheap...
scripts.translation:
[海斯]
哈...看來你想打聽寶藏的事。
不過，這情報可不便宜...

scripts.text:
[La Ed]
Plus, we'll need a little
a little something in case
*cough!* ^555555we don't find
anything at all.^000000
scripts.translation:
[拉·埃德]
而且，萬一*咳咳！* ^555555我們什麼也沒找到，^000000 我們也需要一點小小的補償。

scripts.text:
[La Ed, Haith]
If you pay us 1,000 zeny, we will tell you!
scripts.translation:
[拉·埃德，海斯]
如果你付給我們1,000 Zeny，我們就告訴你！

scripts.text: Pay 1,000 zeny
scripts.translation: 支付1,000 Zeny

scripts.text: Refuse to pay
scripts.translation: 拒絕支付

scripts.text:
[Haith]
Hahahaha! You the man!
scripts.translation:
[海斯]
哈哈哈哈哈！你真是個大好人！

scripts.text:
[La Ed]
Okay, not too long ago, a famous
adventurer named Niels came back from his travels.
scripts.translation:
[拉·埃德]
不久前，有位叫尼爾斯的著名冒險者旅行回來了。

scripts.text:
[Haith]
*Whispers*
^555555He brought a big box with him.^000000
scripts.translation:
[海斯]
*小聲*
^555555他帶了一個大箱子回來。^000000

scripts.text:
[La Ed]
Also, he came back in the middle
of the night without telling
anyone. So, of course he's got
some secret, don't you think?
scripts.translation:
[拉·埃德]
而且，他是在半夜回來的，誰也沒告訴。所以，他肯定有什麼秘密，你不覺得嗎？

scripts.text:
[Haith]
What could be inside that box~?
It just has to be treasure!!
scripts.translation:
[海斯]
那個箱子裡會是什麼呢~？
那肯定就是寶藏！！

scripts.text:
[La Ed]
So! We decided to go on a journey to find treasure of our own-!!
scripts.translation:
[拉·埃德]
所以！我們決定出發，尋找自己的寶藏！

scripts.text:
[Haith]
The problem is, we are not sure
whether or not Niels would tell
us the location of where he
found the treasure...
scripts.translation:
[海斯]
問題是，我們不確定尼爾斯會不會告訴我們他是在哪裡發現寶藏的...

scripts.text:
[La Ed]
Because Niels always treat us like
we're stupid!! Bah~!!
scripts.translation:
[拉·埃德]
因為尼爾斯總是把我們當傻瓜！！哼~！！

scripts.text: Where is this Niels person?
scripts.translation: 那個叫尼爾斯的人在哪裡？

scripts.text:
[La Ed]
He's staying at the northern part
of this village.
scripts.translation:
[拉·埃德]
他住在村子的北邊。

scripts.text:
[Haith]
Since we gave you good information,
we expect that you pay us back!
scripts.translation:
[海斯]
既然我們給了你這麼好的情報，你就得回報我們！

scripts.text:
[La Ed, Haith]
Good luck!
scripts.translation:
[拉·埃德，海斯]
祝你好運！

scripts.text:
[La Ed]
Oh well~! If you don't have the money, then we can't give you the information~
scripts.translation:
[拉·埃德]
哎呀~！如果你沒有錢，那我們也沒辦法給你情報~

scripts.text:
[Haith]
Bah! Whatever~
scripts.translation:
[海斯]
哼！隨便啦~

scripts.text:
[Iriya]
Mr. Niels is at the table in the
corner. He has many interesting
stories about the world.
scripts.translation:
[伊莉婭]
尼爾斯先生在角落的桌子旁。他有很多關於這個世界的有趣故事。

scripts.text:
[Iriya]
I am not sure where he has been
this time. He just laughs and
says 'I don't think I am fit
for this teaching job.'
scripts.translation:
[伊莉婭]
我不確定他這次去了哪裡。他只是笑著說“我覺得我不適合這份教書的工作”。

scripts.text:
[Iriya]
In the meantime, people keep
visiting Mr. Niels... and I
can't help but wonder...
Where has he gone?
scripts.translation:
[伊莉婭]
這陣子一直有人來拜訪尼爾斯先生...
我也忍不住好奇，他到底去了哪裡？

scripts.text:
[Niels]
Hmm? What's that look for?
Ah~ You must of heard the rumors
of me finding some kind of
treasure. Yeah, that's understandable...
scripts.translation:
[尼爾斯]
嗯？幹嗎這樣看我？
啊~你聽說我找到寶藏的傳聞了吧？難怪...

scripts.text:
[Niels]
Well, those rumors of me stumbling
on some wonderful treasure is
just the result of overactive
imaginations. All I've found
was a little something to add
to my collection.
scripts.translation:
[尼爾斯]
說我偶然發現了驚人寶藏，不過是大家想得太多。
我只找到了一點能添進收藏的小東西。

scripts.text:
[Niels]
But...since I've proven to myself
that 'it' actually exists by
seeing it with my own eyes,
to me, what I've obtained is a
valuable treasure.
scripts.translation:
[尼爾斯]
不過...我親眼見到了“它”，證明了它確實存在。
所以對我而言，這份收穫就是珍貴的寶藏。

scripts.text:
[Niels]
This village of Comodo!
Don't you think the caves are too
small and narrow for some reason?
scripts.translation:
[尼爾斯]
說起克魔島，你不覺得這裡的洞穴莫名地又小又窄嗎？

scripts.text:
[Niels]
So I was thinking about it...
And I came to the conclusion that
there should be something hidden
inside the cave...
scripts.translation:
[尼爾斯]
我一直琢磨這件事...
最後認定，洞穴深處一定還藏著什麼...

scripts.text:
[Niels]
And then!
I finally found it.
The patch to 'the place'
that no one has ever found!
scripts.translation:
[尼爾斯]
然後！我終於找到了！
通往那個無人發現過的“地方”的路！

scripts.text:
[Niels]
.......Hm?

[Niels]
I was expecting a spectacular and
rather dramatic sound effect
for my declaration!
Eh, oh well...
scripts.translation:
[尼爾斯]
我還以為宣佈這麼重大的發現時，會響起氣勢十足的音效呢！
唉，算了...

scripts.text:
[Niels]
Well, in the spirit of discovery,
don't ever think of asking me
about directions to 'the place'
or about what is in 'the place.'
I wouldn't want to spoil the
surprise.
scripts.translation:
[尼爾斯]
冒險就要有探索精神，別問我“那個地方”怎麼走，也別問那裡有什麼。
我可不想提前揭曉，毀了驚喜。

scripts.text:
[Niels]
If you're a real adventurer,
I expect you to scream at the
top of your lungs...
scripts.translation:
[尼爾斯]
真正的冒險者，就該扯開嗓子大喊...

scripts.text:
[Niels]
'Ahhhh! I need to know what it
is!!' Kick the door open and run
like hell to find this place on
your own!!
scripts.translation:
[尼爾斯]
“啊啊啊！我非得知道那是什麼！”
然後踹開門，飛奔出去，親自找到那個地方！

scripts.text:
[Niels]
Now! Hurry and seek this place
out! Will this place be a totally
new world, or will it be a trap
to hell?! Go forth, meet your
destiny, adventurer!
scripts.translation:
[尼爾斯]
快去尋找吧！那裡是全新的世界，還是通往地獄的陷阱？！
去迎接你的命運吧，冒險者！

scripts.text:

You're not one of us, are you?
scripts.translation:
[???]
咦？
你不是我們這邊的人吧？

scripts.text:

My name is Haatan.

我叫哈坦。

scripts.text:
[Haatan]
...*Sigh*
I am sorry, but I cannot play with
you right now. My parent's house
was struck by lightning yesterday
and it burned down our roof...
scripts.translation:
[哈坦]
...*嘆氣*
對不起，我現在不能和你玩。
昨天我家被雷劈了，
屋頂都燒壞了...

scripts.text:
[Haatan]
 . . . !

[Haatan]
Oh yes! Could you help me?
You look pretty well off...
Can donate some money for
re-constructing my parents' house?
You Rune-Midgartsians are all
richer than Utans! I beg you!
scripts.translation:
[哈坦]
對了！你能幫幫我嗎？你看起來挺有錢的...
能捐點錢，幫我爸媽重建房子嗎？
你們盧恩·米德加茲人都比烏坦人富有！求求你！

Thank you so much!
scripts.translation:
[哈坦]
非常感謝你！

scripts.text:
[Pasto]
Oh my god~! Finally,
another Rune-Midgartsian!
I've never seen anyone from
home in this place before!
Nice to meet you, my name is Pasto!
scripts.translation:
[帕斯托]
天哪~！終於又見到盧恩·米德加茲的同鄉了！
以前我在這裡從沒遇見過家鄉的人！
很高興認識你，我叫帕斯托！

scripts.text:
[Pasto]
This place is called Umbala.
The local people in this village
have formed a culture that's
totally different from other
places I've been.
scripts.translation:
[帕斯托]
這裡叫汶巴拉。
當地人的文化，和我去過的其他地方完全不同。

scripts.text:
[Pasto]
I guess it's because this
place has been isolated from
other regions because of its
geographical features.
scripts.translation:
[帕斯托]
我想，是因為這裡地形特殊，長期與外界隔絕吧。

scripts.text:
[Pasto]
They look different from us, and
use a language that is still very
confusing to me. I was also
confounded by their different use
of facial expression.
scripts.translation:
[帕斯托]
他們的長相和我們不同，語言我至今也聽不明白。
連表情表達的意思都不一樣，真讓我摸不著頭腦。

scripts.text:
[Pasto]
Of course, there are some
similarities. However, you might
want to be careful about certain
issues.
scripts.translation:
[帕斯托]
當然，也有相似之處。
不過，有些地方你得特別留意。

scripts.text:
[Pasto]
Sometimes, what you say or do
or do could be misinterpreted as
having the totally opposite meaning.
scripts.translation:
[帕斯托]
有時，你說的話、做的事，會被理解成完全相反的意思。

scripts.text:
[Pasto]
I wish I could speak their
language...*Sigh*
...Or I wish I could meet more
people here that speak my
language...I...I'm...
So very lonely...*Sob*
scripts.translation:
[帕斯托]
真希望我會說他們的語言...*嘆氣*
或者，能在這裡多遇到幾個說我們語言的人...
我...我真的好孤單...*抽泣*

scripts.text:
[Yuwooki]
Umbah umbah woogawoo...
oops, sorry! I'm so used
to speaking in Utan by now.
It's a pleasure to meet you.
scripts.translation:
[尤烏基]
Umbah umbah woogawoo...
哎呀，抱歉！我已經習慣說烏坦語了。
很高興認識你。

scripts.text:
[Yuwooki]
I never imagined that I would
meet another person from
the homeland in this village.
Hahahahah~!
scripts.translation:
[尤烏基]
沒想到能在這個村子遇見同鄉。
哈哈哈哈~！

scripts.text:
[Yuwooki]
I came here to seek strong people
to help me master my fighting
skills. But I was soon frustrated
because it took me a long
time to learn the language...
scripts.translation:
[尤烏基]
我來這裡，是想找些強者，幫我磨練戰鬥技巧。
可學語言花了太長時間，很快就讓我灰心了...

scripts.text:
[Yuwooki]
Well, now I am kind of used to my
circumstances. Even though it
took me a while to used to
Utan culture. Hahahaha~!
scripts.translation:
[尤烏基]
不過，現在也算適應這裡的生活了。
雖然熟悉烏坦文化花了不少時間。哈哈哈哈~！

scripts.text:
[Yuwooki]
But you know what was the weirdest
thing I found out about Utan
culture? At first the Utan men
seemed to have, shall we say, a
strong species preservation instinct.
scripts.translation:
[尤烏基]
你知道烏坦文化裡，最讓我覺得奇怪的是什麼嗎？
一開始，烏坦男人給我的印象是...怎麼說呢，繁衍後代的本能特別強。

scripts.text:
[Yuwooki]
There are many Utan playboys in
this village. Some may think
the Utans are primitive in
this respect, but...
scripts.translation:
[尤烏基]
村裡有不少烏坦花花公子。
有人也許會覺得，他們在這方面很原始，不過...

scripts.text:
[Yuwooki]
As I learned more about them,
I eventually realized that their
courtship rituals are actually
more advanced than anything the
Rune-Midgarts culture has to offer.
scripts.translation:
[尤烏基]
瞭解得越多，我越發現，他們的求偶方式其實比盧恩·米德加茲的高明得多。

scripts.text:
[Yuwooki]
It's really quite fascinating.
I'm actually still learning
quite much from the Utan
playboys and their awesome methods.
scripts.translation:
[尤烏基]
真是有意思。
我現在還在向那些烏坦花花公子學習他們厲害的招數呢。

scripts.text:
[Jertan]
Bungee jumping can be dangerous,
and you can risk your life doing
it. We Utans have consider
bungee jumping an important
part of the ceremony of
becoming an adult.
scripts.translation:
[傑爾坦]
高空彈跳很危險，甚至可能丟掉性命。
但對我們烏坦人來說，它是成人禮的重要環節。

Completing the bungee jump
is very difficult to do.
Today, we are here in celebration
of the people that made it and
have shown their courage.
scripts.translation:
[阿羅坦]
成功完成高空彈跳可不容易。
今天，我們就是來慶祝那些成功挑戰、證明了自己勇氣的人。

[Klumatan]
It's really scary, falling from
such a high place...
But I guess you have to do it,
otherwise no one will ever
consider you a grownup.
scripts.translation:
[克盧馬坦]
從那麼高的地方跳下來，真的很嚇人...
可又不得不跳，不然誰都不會把你當大人。

scripts.text:
[Klumatan]
I guess I don't want to
be a grownup right away.
But some kids my age are
in too big of a hurry
to not be kids anymore.
scripts.translation:
[克盧馬坦]
我還不想這麼快就長大。
可有些和我同齡的孩子，卻急著告別童年。

What up, loser!
scripts.translation:

嘿，窩囊廢！

scripts.text:
[Bertan]
What's the matter,
ya big Rune-Midgartsian?!?!
I just called you a 'loser!'
I guess you're too stupid
to understand!!
Hahahahahahaahahhahaha~!
scripts.translation:
[貝爾坦]
怎麼了，你這個大塊頭盧恩·米德加茲人？！
我剛才叫你“窩囊廢”呢！笨得聽不懂吧？！
哈哈哈哈哈~！

scripts.text:
[Bertan]
...
Uh...oh!

[Bertan]
It looks like you can understand
me--! Good job, good job!
Alright, by way of apology,
do you want to hear a joke?
scripts.translation:
[貝爾坦]
看來你聽得懂啊！不錯，不錯！
那我講個笑話，算是賠禮，怎麼樣？

scripts.text:
[Bertan]
Alright, alright.
Here we go.
Ummmm...
Alright, I got one.
scripts.translation:
[貝爾坦]
好，好，來了。
嗯...好，我想到了。

scripts.text:
[Bertan]
What did the Rune-Midgartsian
say to the Savage?
...
scripts.translation:
[貝爾坦]
盧恩·米德加茲人對野豬說了什麼？
...

scripts.text:
[Bertan]
I don't know...
But they didn't have any
trouble understanding
each other!!! HAHAHAHA~!
Get it? 'Cuz, like,
they're both pigs~!
scripts.translation:
[貝爾坦]
我不知道...
不過他們交流起來毫無障礙！哈哈哈哈~！
懂了吧？因為他們都是豬~！

scripts.text:
[Bertan]
Not funny, huh?
Oh well. I guess my
sense of humor is just
too sophisticated.
scripts.translation:
[貝爾坦]
不好笑？
算了，看來我的幽默太高深了。

scripts.text:
[Bertan]
Okay...what's the best
way to tame an Orc Lady?
Give up..?
scripts.translation:
[貝爾坦]
好吧...怎麼才能馴服獸人女子？
猜不到...？

scripts.text:
[Bertan]
With a wedding ring!
HAHAHAHAHAHAHHA!
Oh God~ I'm hilarious!!
scripts.translation:
[貝爾坦]
用結婚戒指！
哈哈哈哈哈！
天哪~ 我太搞笑了！！

scripts.text:
[Bertan]
...
...Wait.
Wait a minute...
scripts.translation:
[貝爾坦]
...
...等等。
等一下...

scripts.text:
[Bertan]
That's not even funny...
Just incredibly...
Scary...
Brrr--!
She's hideous!!
scripts.translation:
[貝爾坦]
這根本不好笑...
簡直...太可怕了...
嘶——！她可真醜！

scripts.text:
[Bertan]
Actually...forget it.
scripts.translation:
[貝爾坦]
其實...算了。

scripts.text:
[Bertan]
I was going to say a
knock knock joke about
Isis, but then decided
that kind of humor is
too low brow.
...Zing!
scripts.translation:
[貝爾坦]
我本來想講個蛇女伊絲的敲門笑話，可又覺得這種幽默太低俗了。
...叮！

scripts.text:
[Bertan]
Why are Rune-Midgartsians
SOOoOOoo...
Um, hmmmmm.
Maybe that joke
isn't so good for this
situation, yeah?
scripts.translation:
[貝爾坦]
為什麼盧恩·米德加茲人那麼——
呃，嗯...
這個笑話好像不適合現在講，對吧？

scripts.text:
[Bertan]
Okay, why is it that
GMs prefer not to be
seen...? Give up?
scripts.translation:
[貝爾坦]
好，為什麼GM不喜歡讓人看見自己...？
猜不到？

scripts.text:
[Bertan]
BECAUSE THOSE GUYS WEAR
SKIRTS ~! HAHAHA!
OH MAN, I MADE A FUNNY!
scripts.translation:
[貝爾坦]
因為那些傢伙穿裙子~！哈哈哈！
天哪，我真會講笑話！

scripts.text:
[Bertan]
*Whew* Yowza~
Oh, man.
Utterly classic.
scripts.translation:
[貝爾坦]
*呼* 哇哦~
天哪。
太經典了。

scripts.text:
[Bertan]
A Crusader, an Alchemist and a Novice walk into a bar.
scripts.translation:
[貝爾坦]
一個十字軍、一個鍊金術士和一個初心者走進酒吧。

scripts.text:
[Bertan]
Inside, they see a sign that
says '^CC0000Monster Help Agency:
LADIES ONLY.^000000'
scripts.translation:
[貝爾坦]
他們看見一塊牌子，上面寫著：^CC0000“魔物援助所：僅限女士。”^000000

scripts.text:
[Bertan]
'^000099Oh!^000000' says the Crusader.
'^000099It's a lucky thing we are
all ladies.^000000' She goes up
and says '^000099Gimmie a ride.^000000'
Kinda rude for a Crusader,
but whatever.
scripts.translation:
[貝爾坦]
十字軍說：^000099“哦！”^000000
^000099“幸好我們都是女士。”^000000
她走上前：^000099“給我找個坐騎。”^000000
十字軍這麼說有點沒禮貌，不過算了。

scripts.text:
[Bertan]
Out of nowhere, this
Grand PecoPeco appears
and is all '^CC0000I'll give you
a ride, baby. Careful, this
road can get buuuuumpy.^000000'
And then they're off.
scripts.translation:
[貝爾坦]
突然，一隻大嘴鳥冒了出來，說：^CC0000“寶貝，我載你。小心，這路可顛——得很。”^000000
然後他們就出發了。

scripts.text:
[Bertan]
Next comes the Alchemist
and she's like '^330099I need
help killing Zombies^000000' and
then this Marine Sphere
comes from out of
nowhere and is all...
scripts.translation:
[貝爾坦]
接著，鍊金術士說：^330099“我要找幫手殺腐屍。”^000000
一隻氣泡蟲突然冒了出來，說...

scripts.text:
[Bertan]
'^CC0000I got your fire. Careful
baby, touch me the wrong
way and I might just
exploooode.^000000' So then
they're off on their
merry way too.
scripts.translation:
[貝爾坦]
^CC0000“火力包在我身上。小心，寶貝，碰錯地方，我可會炸——開哦。”^000000
然後他們也高高興興地出發了。

scripts.text:
[Bertan]
Finally, the Novice
comes up and says
'^006633I need someone to
party with.^000000'
scripts.translation:
[貝爾坦]
最後，初心者走上前說：^006633“我需要一個隊友。”^000000

scripts.text:
[Bertan]
Out of nowhere, this
Hode pops up and says...
scripts.translation:
[貝爾坦]
突然，一條蚯蚓鑽了出來，說...

scripts.text:
[Bertan]
'^CC0000I know some people
but let me check my
Rolodex. HODE on!^000000'
....
scripts.translation:
[貝爾坦]
^CC0000“我認識幾個人，先查查通訊錄。蚯等一下！”^000000
...

[貝爾坦]
...
...
還是不好笑？

scripts.text:
[Bertan]
Well, come on!
I can't be funny
all the time, you know?
scripts.translation:
[貝爾坦]
拜託！我總不能每次都逗你笑吧？

aren't you? Have you ever been bungee jumping?
scripts.translation:
[布林卡坦]
咦？你是盧恩·米德加茲人吧？玩過高空彈跳嗎？

scripts.text: Yeah

scripts.text:

Whoa, what a surprise! I never
would have thought someone from
outside would know how to do it.
Okay, I'll take your word for
it and welcome you to our village.
scripts.translation:

哇，真意外！沒想到外地人也會高空彈跳。
好，我相信你，歡迎來到我們的村莊。

scripts.text:

Er, I see...
As part of the ceremony of
adulthood, all Utans have to do
a bungee jump. When I grow up,
I'm gonna do it too, and prove
to everybody that I am a man!
scripts.translation:

呃，這樣啊...
所有烏坦人都要在成人禮上高空彈跳。
等我長大了，也要跳一次，向大家證明我是個男子漢！

scripts.text:
[Weitan]
I too did the bungee jump when I
was young. I remember it well...
It was my first time, and the
ground rushed up to meet me...
For a moment, I thought I was
going to get myself killed...
scripts.translation:
[韋坦]
年輕時，我也跳過高空彈跳，至今記憶猶新...
那是第一次，看著地面飛快地撲來...
有那麼一瞬間，我以為自己要沒命了...

scripts.text:
[Weitan]
But after I made it, I was so
proud of myself~
Some Utans may not agree, but
I think bungee jumping is an
important part of the ceremony
of adulthood.
scripts.translation:
[韋坦]
可成功後，我真的很自豪~
有些烏坦人也許不贊同，但我認為，高空彈跳是成人禮的重要環節。

[Jooltan]
It's been a long time since I last
saw a Rune-Midgartsian~!
Welcome, stranger.
scripts.translation:
[祖爾坦]
好久沒見過盧恩·米德加茲的人了~！
歡迎，外來者。

scripts.text:
[Jooltan]
We Utans use this place for
bungee jumping. Many Utan
youngsters have shown their
bravery, earned their
self-respect, and became
adults in this very place.
scripts.translation:
[祖爾坦]
我們烏坦人在這裡高空彈跳。
許多年輕人都在這裡證明勇氣，贏得自尊，成長為大人。

scripts.text:
[Jooltan]
Oh...right. A few unlucky people
just fell and died after
messing up their bungee jump. And
a few had heart attacks while
looking at other people jumping down...
scripts.translation:
[祖爾坦]
哦...對了，也有幾個倒霉的人，高空彈跳時出了差錯，摔死了。
還有人只是看別人跳，就心臟病發作了...

scripts.text:
[Jooltan]
So...
Be careful when you walk around,
You don't want to fall off.
And if you want to try a bungee
jump, you should get yourself ready.
scripts.translation:
[祖爾坦]
所以...走路小心，別掉下去。
想試試高空彈跳的話，也得先做好準備。

scripts.text:
[Jooltan]
Oh...right. Supposedly,
there's an unidentified
creature living in the water...
So if you happen to get dunked,
get out of there~!
scripts.translation:
[祖爾坦]
哦...對了，據說水裡還住著不明生物...
不小心落水的話，要趕緊爬出來~！

scripts.text:
[Mutakutan]
Umbala has many many trees!
I, Mutakutan, like trees so much.
Heh heh~
scripts.translation:
[穆塔庫坦]
汶巴拉有好多好多樹！我穆塔庫坦最喜歡樹了。
嘿嘿~

scripts.text:
[Mutakutan]
There is one special tree I like
the most! That is the oldest and
biggest tree in Umbala!
No wait, I think it is the oldest
and biggest in the world...
I'm sure it is!
scripts.translation:
[穆塔庫坦]
我最喜歡一棵特別的樹！它是汶巴拉最大、最古老的樹！
不對，應該是全世界最大、最古老的...
我敢肯定！

scripts.text:
[Mutakutan]
It's really really big and old!
It's so tall, even I haven't seen
the top of this tree yet. I tried
climbing it before, but I could
never reach the top...even though
I'm great at tree climbing.
scripts.translation:
[穆塔庫坦]
它真的又大又古老！高得連我都沒見過樹頂。
我試著爬過，可一直沒能爬到頂...我可是很擅長爬樹的。

scripts.text:
[Mutakutan]
Oh, also the fruits from the tree
are very tasty! I bet they are the
most delicious fruit in the world~
Sweet and sour...eating it just
makes you feel refreshed and
invigorated~!
scripts.translation:
[穆塔庫坦]
還有，它結的果子可好吃了！一定是世界上最美味的水果~
酸酸甜甜的...吃了讓人神清氣爽，渾身有勁~！

scripts.text:
[Mutakutan]
There's an amazing story about
this fruit. An old man in my
village was suffering from a
mortal disease...nothing
seemed to help...
scripts.translation:
[穆塔庫坦]
這種果子還有個神奇的故事。
村裡有位老人得了絕症...怎麼治都沒用...

scripts.text:
[Mutakutan]
But after he took medicine made
from the ground leaves of this
tree, he became healthy and sound
again! I think God sent us the
tree to bless us.
scripts.translation:
[穆塔庫坦]
可他喝了用這棵樹的葉子磨成的藥，就恢復健康了！
我想，這是神賜給我們的樹，保佑著我們。

scripts.text:
[Mutakutan]
It's at north of my village, so
why don't you go see the greatness
of this tree for yourself?
scripts.translation:
[穆塔庫坦]
它就在村子北邊，不如親自去看看有多壯觀？
